signatures.description: Implement physically-based image-based lighting in Node: prefilter an equirectangular HDRI into a mip chain using GGX importance sampling (Hammersley sequence, alpha = roughness^2), generate the split-sum BRDF integration LUT over (NdotV, roughness), and evaluate the split-sum approximation against a brute-force Monte Carlo reference. Add multiple-importance sampling with balance/power heuristics so the direct+IBL estimator is unbiased with low variance, and demonstrate white-furnace energy conservation (a constant environment must integrate to the input radiance for every roughness and view angle). Handle non-power-of-two map dimensions with correct solid-angle weighting per texel.
